# Maps MCP connectors

5 maps connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All maps connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/maps](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/maps).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Google Maps](connectors/google-maps.md) | Let your AI search Google Maps with your own API key: find businesses and places by text or around a point, read their address, phone, website, opening hours, rating and reviews, get photos, … | 9 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/google-maps-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-google-maps-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-google-maps-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-google-maps-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-google-maps-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-google-maps-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-google-maps-to-muse) |
| [HERE Geocoding & Search](connectors/here-geocoding.md) | Geocode addresses, reverse-geocode coordinates, autocomplete addresses as-you-type, and search places via the HERE Location Services API. | 5 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/here-geocoding-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-here-geocoding-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-here-geocoding-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-here-geocoding-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-here-geocoding-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-here-geocoding-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-here-geocoding-to-muse) |
